description: This file defines the 'LoanConvenienceData' class, a data structure holding various loan-related temporal details and constraints such as offsets from today and loan term durations in days and months.

classes.name: LoanConvenienceData
classes.description: A data class encapsulating loan timing constraints and durations, including offsets from current date and expected versus actual loan terms.

methods.name: LoanConvenienceData
methods.description: Constructor initializing all loan timing fields with provided values.

methods.name: getMaxSubmittedOnOffsetFromToday
methods.description: Returns the maximum offset from today for loan submission.

methods.name: getMaxApprovedOnOffsetFromToday
methods.description: Returns the maximum offset from today for loan approval.

methods.name: getMaxDisbursedOnOffsetFromToday
methods.description: Returns the maximum offset from today for loan disbursement.

methods.name: getExpectedLoanTermInDays
methods.description: Returns the expected loan term in days.

methods.name: getActualLoanTermInDays
methods.description: Returns the actual loan term in days.

methods.name: getExpectedLoanTermInMonths
methods.description: Returns the expected loan term in months.

methods.name: getActualLoanTermInMonths
methods.description: Returns the actual loan term in months.
